PROBE FIXTURE — SEC-01. The SHAPE of the message that leaked, with SYNTHETIC
credentials. Every token value below is invented and has never been valid
anywhere; the real leaked values are deliberately not reproduced, because
committing them would repeat the incident inside the repository.

Structure copied from the production throw: `_recoverAndRefresh` interpolates
the whole serialised session into the message. Both credential shapes appear,
and they need different arms of the redactor:

  - access_token  — a JWT, recognisable from its value alone
  - refresh_token — a SHORT OPAQUE STRING with no distinguishing shape, findable
                    only by its JSON key
